verdict.summary: The round-2 diff remains correct and narrowly scoped to self-test coverage. `_refused_cleanly` makes a deleted exception-conversion guard observable as a single failed row instead of allowing a raw `ValueError` to abort the remaining suite, while its control rows pin both exception reporting and unchanged refusal/accept behavior. The two new mutants independently reach the exact first-line and tokenisation refusal branches and assert branch-unique message fragments, so unrelated refusals cannot satisfy them. No production trust check is weakened, no permissive path is introduced, and no hostile reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
